Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement plan + weekly pulse — Sunrise Health

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation and lots of alignment on goals. As promised, attaching a first-pass engagement plan that lays out milestones, owners, and target close so we have a shared cadence. Highlights from the call: 

- Business goal: reduce inference latency on clinical search by 40% and cut per-query cost by ~30% via batching and quantization.
- Primary technical stakeholders: Tom (Platform) + Alyssa (Product).
- Legal/procurement timeline: Sunrise prefers a 30-day review window; procurement kickoff targeted for Jun 15.

Immediate next steps (owners & target dates):
1) Sunrise to confirm security questionnaire items / missing evidences — Alyssa — by Jun 7.
2) Redwood to deliver updated engagement plan with SLA options and pricing tiers — Neha — by Jun 9 (attached: engagement_plan_v1.xlsx).
3) Joint architecture session to scope PoC and infra (30–60 days) — Marissa + Tom — propose dates Jun 14–18.
4) Legal to exchange initial SOW draft — Ben — week of Jun 15.

Please review the attachment and call out any missing dependencies or owners. If these dates look tight, tell us which slotted items you want to reprioritize.

Attachments: engagement_plan_v1.xlsx (plan draft), sunrise_sow_draft.pdf (initial SOW stub)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
